name: bg-stars
title: Stars Background
blurb: Parallax starfield that shifts gently with mouse movement.
description: CSS box-shadow stars rendered via motion/react spring physics. Follows pointer position with configurable stiffness/damping for subtle depth effect.
use_when: Space-themed background with passive parallax motion following cursor.
a11y: Parallax motion can disorient; no keyboard equivalent for pointer tracking.
